The refusal_rate doubled versus typical baseline (~0.02-0.03), concentrated in bridge questions where span_2 carries the synthesis burden. The GLM-4.7 generator appears particularly trigger-happy on refusals and susceptible to entity confusion when multiple candidates exist in retrieved chunks.

Refusal patterns (5/20) are instructive: 3 occur with retrieval_complete status, meaning the model saw both gold spans but still declined. This suggests gpt-5.4-mini struggles to synthesize from raw biographical facts without HyDE-style query enrichment. Generation_wrong (9/20) splits across: (a) extraction failures on structured comparisons—numerical counts, temporal ordering—and (b) entity disambiguation errors where the model selects distractor entities co-mentioned in context.

The combined signal: query expansion was masking reasoning brittleness. Without HyDE, the same retriever succeeds, but the generator faces harder synthesis tasks—particularly on comparison reasoning and entity disambiguation in multi-hop chains.
